column1: # Maps ethnicity_verbatim values from harmonized_donor_metadata.csv to HANCESTRO ontology terms.
# HCA-native: terms are descendants of HANCESTRO:0601 (ethnicity) or :0602 (geography),
# as required by HCA Data Portal schema. For CxG builds, assembly scripts apply a
# post-hoc downgrade to :0004 (ancestry) descendants via --target cxg flag.
# Prohibited terms include HANCESTRO:0290 (genetically isolated population) and children,
# which means HANCESTRO:0324 (Ashkenazi Jew) CANNOT be used despite being the most specific term.
# Jewish/Ashkenazi donors are mapped to HANCESTRO:0590 (European American, :0601 ethnicity branch).
#   VERIFY   = mapping is reasonable but original verbatim label has ambiguity worth confirming
#   UNKNOWN  = no ethnicity recorded for these donors
# 287 total donors. 106 have empty ethnicity_verbatim (pal: 22, murrow: 28, twigger: 18, plus scattered others).
# 12 rows flagged VERIFY (ambiguous labels, harmonization errors, or Jewish → European forced mapping).
# Because apparently recording ethnicity was optional for half the field. Science!
